newsitem.title: DENMARK: Icopal to make good Phoenix offer.
newsitem.headline: Icopal to make good Phoenix offer.

text.p: Danish building materials firm Icopal said on Friday its probable bid for road builder Phoenix Contractors would be a generous one.
"Our bid will in no way be stingy," Icopal managing director Hans C. Andreassen told Reuters.
Earlier Icopal said it was "pretty sure" to bid for Phoenix either on Friday or early next week.
The Phoenix board on Thursday advised shareholders to accept an 820 million Danish crown offer by Norway's Rieber & Son, the highest of three bids pending Icopal's move.
Also bidding for Phoenix is heavyweight Danish construction group Superfos, which has said it will not raise its offer of 808 million crowns but considers itself still in the running.

Andreassen's remarks came in response to Phoenix board chairman Henry Petersen's comment to Reuters earlier on Friday that any new offer would have to be considerably higher than Reiber's for it to change its recommendation. --Morten Bonde Pedersen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969652
